about: What this member said on the floor, from the Congressional Record: their own words only, and of those the sentences that name an alignment question's phrases or make a commitment. Written by npm run record:collect (scripts/collect-record.mjs).
name: Becca Balint

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: LIBERTY AND JUSTICE FOR ALL
statements.title: LIBERTY AND JUSTICE FOR ALL
sentences: There is no immigration status that changes that or makes a human being disposable or expendable.
There is a lot of talk in this Chamber all the time about who belongs in this country, but tonight I will ask you this: What do we owe the people whose lives we have put in our hands?

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SECURE AMERICA ACT
statements.title: SECURE AMERICA ACT
sentences: Working families right now can't afford a doctor's visit, and Republicans are worried about multiplying our budget for detention facilities--not lowering healthcare costs, not giving relief to families who are struggling with obscenely high insurance premiums, but instead giving even more money to ICE and Border Patrol.
Trump and his allies do this so you don't see that their policies benefit billionaires and greedy corporations that have hollowed out the middle class in this country.
We should be investing in the working families in our communities across this country.
Mr. Speaker, we should be lowering costs and investing in the working families and communities across this country, not weaponizing our government to go after the most vulnerable.
Mr. Speaker, I rise today in strong opposition to the Republican reconciliation bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: TRUMP AND THE IRS SETTLEMENT/SLUSH FUND
statements.title: TRUMP AND THE IRS SETTLEMENT/SLUSH FUND
sentences: Mr. Speaker, the President has created an entirely corrupt slush fund to give money to his allies, including the violent attackers who beat police officers on January 6.
Former Capitol Police Officers have already filed a lawsuit to stop it.
I am cosponsoring a bill to put an end to this disgusting, illegal corruption.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PARENTAL RIGHTS OVER THE EDUCATION AND CARE OF THEIR KIDS ACT
statements.title: PARENTAL RIGHTS OVER THE EDUCATION AND CARE OF THEIR KIDS ACT
sentences: They have no plan to end the illegal and unpopular war in Iran.

This time they want to give the Trump administration broad authority to cut off Federal public school funding if a school teaches or advances anything that the administration deems to be gender ideology.

A teacher doesn't get parental consent before using a student's nickname on a school form; a book in their library includes a transgender character; a teacher has a Pride Flag hanging in the classroom.
This book censorship bill would chill expression across the book industry, hurt small businesses, and decrease the variety of books in the marketplace.
H.R. 2616 is a national book ban bill, and even its authors likely cannot say where the banning will stop.

The prohibition on use of ESEA funds to ``teach or advance gender ideology'' could impact everything from picture books about crayons to Plato's Symposium, and it appears to apply to library materials as well as curriculum.
The key term, ``gender ideology,'' is defined only in an executive order that has not been approved by Congress and could change in future administrations.
In states where book bans are most common, booksellers have been forced to shrink or discontinue their school programs, impacting jobs and local economies.
We have alread started to see less diversity in the book market due to book bans.

Book ban laws censor age- appropriate stories that people just do not want told, increasingly target history, and disproportionately impact people of color, LGBTQIA2S+ people, and people with disabilities.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: AMERICANS DON'T NEED LECTURES
statements.title: AMERICANS DON'T NEED LECTURES
sentences: Maybe it is because people are drowning in student debt, paying outrageous rents, and can't imagine adding childcare to their list of expenses.

They are struggling to get by while you, among the rich and powerful, stand and lecture them in a gold-plated room among other people who are clearly and totally out of touch with the American people.
You can't serve in an administration that cuts healthcare, attacks Medicaid, drives up costs for working people and then act shocked because people say they can't afford to have kids.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: NO SPECIAL TREATMENT FOR THE EPSTEIN CLASS
statements.title: NO SPECIAL TREATMENT FOR THE EPSTEIN CLASS
sentences: Mr. Speaker, Ghislaine Maxwell lured countless children into Epstein's global pedophile ring.
Whistleblowers tell us that she is being waited on hand and foot.

The judge who oversaw the case said the evidence established that ``Ms. Maxwell directly and repeatedly and over the course of many years participated in a horrific scheme to entice, transport, and traffic underage girls, some as young as 14 for sexual abuse by and with Jeffrey Epstein.'' Obviously, she should not be in a cushy, minimum security prison.
This administration must end the special treatment for the Epstein class. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: WHAT HAPPENED TO ALIYA RAHMAN
statements.title: WHAT HAPPENED TO ALIYA RAHMAN
sentences: We owe Aliya and all Americans real accountability, and I will not stop demanding it on the floor of this House.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: HORRIFIC ICE ABUSES
statements.title: HORRIFIC ICE ABUSES
sentences: There are people of color across this country afraid to leave their homes because right now ICE and Border Patrol will detain anyone who they think they can use to meet a quota based on the color of their skin or the accent that they are using.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ICE
statements.title: ICE
sentences: Americans do not support this, and I will be their voice tonight on the floor.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: WHERE IS THE OUTRAGE
statements.title: WHERE IS THE OUTRAGE
sentences: We take Venezuelan oil at gunpoint, engage in regime change and nation building, and then the President personally controls the proceeds?

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: BE THE VOICE OF MORAL GRANDEUR AND SPIRITUAL AUDACITY
statements.title: BE THE VOICE OF MORAL GRANDEUR AND SPIRITUAL AUDACITY
sentences: We have children being zip-tied, car windows smashed, people tackled and dragged, and guns pointed at unarmed bystanders.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 1834, BREAKING THE GRIDLOCK ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF H.R. 1834, BREAKING THE GRIDLOCK ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, 1 week ago today, Republicans allowed the ACA premium tax credits to expire after telling us there was no money to do so.
Just 3 days later, the President found money, a lot of money, to pay for a very extensive and expensive military raid to capture the President of Venezuela.
This regime change and the nation building that will come later is going to cost us additional billions of dollars.
Mr. Speaker, I urge a ``yes'' vote.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: A SOMBER DAY OF REMEMBRANCE
statements.title: A SOMBER DAY OF REMEMBRANCE
sentences: Our Capitol Police are still being treated with disrespect and now denigration from the President who today has accused them of somehow being responsible for their own beatings.

Mr. Speaker, the leader of this Chamber is bound by law to hang the plaque in remembrance of what these brave men and women did on January 6, and there is no excuse, no excuse, for his moral failure. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECT CHILDREN'S INNOCENCE ACT
statements.title: PROTECT CHILDREN'S INNOCENCE ACT
sentences: The science is clear: Evidence-based, medically necessary care for transgender youth is safe, effective, and supported by every major medical association in the United States, including the American Medical Association and the American Academy of Pediatrics.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ANOTHER DISGUSTING PARDON BY DONALD TRUMP
statements.title: ANOTHER DISGUSTING PARDON BY DONALD TRUMP
sentences: Joseph Schwartz ran a nationwide nursing home empire and stole $38 million through Medicaid and tax fraud.
Trump and the Republicans cut $1 trillion from Medicaid, and Americans are not going to have their healthcare.
I will tell you today about Joseph Schwartz.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: JUAN ORLANDO HERNANDEZ, FORMER PRESIDENT OF HONDURAS
statements.title: JUAN ORLANDO HERNANDEZ, FORMER PRESIDENT OF HONDURAS
sentences: He was convicted by an American jury for working with drug cartels to move 400 tons of cocaine through Honduras to the United States.
Trump is literally rewarding a narco-terrorist.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: RAISING A QUESTION OF THE PRIVILEGES OF THE HOUSE
statements.title: RAISING A QUESTION OF THE PRIVILEGES OF THE HOUSE
sentences: As Border Patrol Commander Gregory Bovino has indiscriminately launched chemical agents in residential neighborhoods and kidnapped people off the streets, the people of Illinois' Fourth District have had a strong champion in Chuy Garcia, standing alongside them every step of the way to demand justice.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong support of my colleague, Congressman Chuy Garcia, who is my seatmate on the Judiciary Committee.
I urge my colleagues to keep all of these things in mind.
I urge my colleagues to keep this in mind.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: MEDICARE FOR ALL
statements.title: MEDICARE FOR ALL
sentences: For the last 15 years, all they have done is try to repeal, defund, deauthorize, and dismantle the Affordable Care Act with no alternative ever presented.
Mr. Speaker, I will tell you the plan: Medicare for all.
It is that every American has access to affordable healthcare, to good jobs, to good schools, to clean air and water, housing they can actually afford, safer communities, and a functioning democracy.
We are going to continue to fight. ____________________

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: FIGHTING FOR AFFORDABLE, QUALITY HEALTHCARE
statements.title: FIGHTING FOR AFFORDABLE, QUALITY HEALTHCARE
sentences: Mr. Speaker, so over at the Centers for Medicaid & Medicaid Services, the administrator, Dr. Oz--yes, that guy--decided they should curb waste by letting the government use AI to decide if your medical procedure is really necessary.
Right now, there are over 70 million Americans who rely on Medicare and Medicaid for their insurance.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STREAMLINING PROCUREMENT FOR EFFECTIVE EXECUTION AND DELIVERY AND NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026
statements.title: STREAMLINING PROCUREMENT FOR EFFECTIVE EXECUTION AND DELIVERY AND NATIONAL DEFENSE AUTHORIZATION ACT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2026
sentences: If passed, this amendment would immediately prohibit TRICARE coverage of mental health counseling for transgender young people.
This amendment would take away mental health care services for transgender kids of servicemembers.

This amendment is intentionally discriminatory and will result in higher rates of mental health issues and suicide for trans youth, kids who already experience higher rates of depression, anxiety, and suicide compared to their peers.
All young people in this country should have access to the mental health care that they need, full stop.

Forcing servicemembers to choose between being able to provide healthcare for their family, for their kids, or serving their country does not make our military stronger, does not make our country safer, and it will not--no matter what the Member says, it will not make transgender people in this country disappear.
Mr. Chair, I rise today in strong opposition to this amendment.
I urge my colleagues to vote ``no.''

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: PROVIDING FOR CONSIDERATION OF SENATE AMENDMENT TO H.R. 1, ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: Mr. Speaker, I ask unanimous consent to amend the rule to make in order the amendment at the desk that protects against any cuts to Medicaid and SNAP.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: This bill is for billionaires and not for Americans.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: WHAT AMERICANS WANT
statements.title: WHAT AMERICANS WANT
sentences: They don't want to add trillions of dollars to the debt, and they sure as hell do not want the wealthy to continue to get rich off the backs of the rest of us.
All this bill does is take and take and take away from working people and provide it, once again, to the billionaires who do not need it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ICE TURNS COURTHOUSES INTO TRAPS
statements.title: ICE TURNS COURTHOUSES INTO TRAPS
sentences: The very places that immigrants are supposed to go to follow a legal path to citizenship have now become traps to lure people in so that they can be arrested, detained, and disappeared.
Last month, in San Francisco, four asylum-seekers were taken by ICE after their hearings were over.
Republicans claim over and over again in committees that this is only about illegal immigration.
It is also a clear tactic to instill fear in all of us so that we will be intimidated into submission and stop standing up for our neighbors.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUPPORTING DAVID HUERTA
statements.title: SUPPORTING DAVID HUERTA
sentences: The head of the SEIU California union was arrested in Los Angeles while exercising his First Amendment rights to speech and assembly, rights that are guaranteed to all of us in the Constitution.
The Trump administration is now going after judges, Members of Congress, political opponents, students, law firms, reporters, Governors, and now the leader of a powerful labor union.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: STOP RENAMING SHIPS
statements.title: STOP RENAMING SHIPS
sentences: I urge him to stop spending his time renaming ships because he wants to pretend that we don't exist.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REPUBLICAN BUDGET WILL MAKE US SICKER
statements.title: REPUBLICAN BUDGET WILL MAKE US SICKER
sentences: The Republican budget slashes billions of dollars from Medicaid and food assistance programs.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
statements.title: ONE BIG BEAUTIFUL BILL ACT
sentences: I urge my colleagues to reject this cruel, cynical bill.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: GOP TAX SCAM HURTS EVERYONE
statements.title: GOP TAX SCAM HURTS EVERYONE
sentences: Republicans are so out of touch with the reality of American families right now, and it is shocking to call these cuts not meaningful when their bill will hurt working families.
It is to give the very wealthy another big tax cut and deliver tax breaks to billionaires and corporations, people who absolutely don't need any more assistance.

While that is happening, in real time, my colleagues are spending time demanding more work requirements for Medicaid recipients when we know that almost half of adults on Medicaid are already working.
They are working, and 27 percent of those working-age adults on Medicaid are disabled.
It couldn't be more obvious that they are just looking to remove more people from the Medicaid rolls in order to have more money to give tax breaks to billionaires and corporations.
Prescription drug prices are too high.
Costs for consumers and small businesses are just going to go up because of the asinine tariff regime that we have been dealt.
That is why we have to be here, raising the alarm about what is happening in this bill with Medicaid.
This bill that cuts Medicaid is a statement of values.
It is about propping up billionaires and kicking the rest of us in the teeth while they do it.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUSPENDING THE WRIT OF HABEAS CORPUS
statements.title: SUSPENDING THE WRIT OF HABEAS CORPUS
sentences: Trump adviser Stephen Miller and perhaps the most joyless man in America recently said that Trump is actively looking at suspending the writ of habeas corpus.
Habeas corpus is the right we all have to challenge in court if we are detained and locked up.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
statements.title: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
sentences: Republicans control the House, the Senate, and the White House, and they could be passing legislation right now to actually lower costs for families on groceries, prescription drugs, and housing.
They have proposed a budget that gives massive tax cuts to the wealthiest and the corporations.
They will pay for it by making cuts to Medicaid to the tune of $880 billion and deep cuts to SNAP benefits, food assistance to families.

When I vote against this Republican budget, I will be thinking about all of the working families back in Vermont, thinking of the families who aren't going to be able to drop their kids off at a Head Start program, and thinking about the small businesses who tell me that the Trump on-again, off-again global tariffs are crushing them.
Mr. Speaker, I rise in strong opposition to the Republican budget.
Mr. Speaker, I urge my colleagues to reject this reckless budget.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECT DUE PROCESS
statements.title: PROTECT DUE PROCESS
sentences: He is a son, a brother, a makeup artist, and a hairdresser.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: REPEALING GREEN SUBSIDIES
statements.title: REPEALING GREEN SUBSIDIES
sentences: Taking a knee, you have got skin in the game.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
statements.title: CONCURRENT RESOLUTION ON THE BUDGET FOR FISCAL YEAR 2025
sentences: They could be passing legislation to actually make our lives better, to lower costs on groceries, on prescription drugs.
They have proposed a budget that gives massive, massive tax cuts to the wealthiest and corporations in this country.
It is long past time for them to stop lecturing us about the debt when they know full well that their math is not mathing.
They are adding to the deficit with this program, and they are literally giving the money away to the wealthiest who do not need it.
When I vote on this Republican budget, I will be thinking of all the working families back home in Vermont, people who sent me here to work on their behalf, not against them.
Mr. Chair, I am thinking of the small businesses in Vermont that have reached out to me to say that Trump's proposed tariff war with Canada is going to crush them.
I am thinking about the 150,000 Vermonters who are dependent on Medicaid.
Mr. Chair, I rise in strong opposition to the Republican budget.
I urge my colleagues to reject this unfair budget.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PUTIN'S MERCILESS WAR
statements.title: PUTIN'S MERCILESS WAR
sentences: Mr. Speaker, Russia invaded the sovereign nation of Ukraine.
Vladimir Putin is the aggressor.
Putin has mercilessly continued this war for over 3 years now; a war that has led to immeasurable suffering for Ukraine and a shocking death toll of both Ukrainians and Russians.
Now the United States stands with Russia and North Korea against Ukraine and all of our allies in Europe?

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: SUPPORTING FEDERAL WORKERS
statements.title: SUPPORTING FEDERAL WORKERS
sentences: I ask Americans: Do we really want to put our Nation at risk so that billionaires can get a massive tax cut?
What this is about is firing our Federal workforce to fund tax cuts for billionaires.
Mr. Speaker, I am here today to stand with our Federal workers and civil servants and to tell them that we will fight these illegal actions.
I will tell you, Mr. Speaker, I am deeply concerned that the illegal purge of our civil servants at the Department of Justice and at the FBI will lead to another 9/11 terrorist attack.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: General Leave
statements.title: General Leave
sentences: This is about the attackers who beat cops with pipes and flagpoles and tasers and mace, who literally stomped on police and tried to poke their eyes out.
Among those who are angry is the Fraternal Order of Police, the largest police union in the U.S., and the International Association of Chiefs of Police.
They understand, more than anyone, that this puts law enforcement at risk.

In a statement, they said: ``When perpetrators of crimes, especially serious crimes, are not held fully accountable, it sends a dangerous message that the consequences for attacking law enforcement are not severe.'' They further worried that it could encourage more violence against law enforcement.
If you can viciously attack a police officer and get off scot-free, what kind of message is that?
Over the last 2 years, I have had the opportunity to get to know many of the officers on the Capitol Police force.
These pardons are part of a concerted effort to rewrite what happened on January 6.
If we don't push back on this perverted rewriting of history, we can look forward to our children and our grandchildren learning about the glories of January 6, 2021.
What Donald Trump has done on day one is to say to the Capitol Police: I value violent felons more than I value you.

statements.where: Floor speech, Congressional Record: PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND GIRLS IN SPORTS ACT OF 2025
statements.title: PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND GIRLS IN SPORTS ACT OF 2025
sentences: Mr. Speaker, actually, I urge colleagues on both sides of the aisle to reject this government overreach.
